carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Hand baggage must not exceed 55 x 40 x 23 cm.

weight_economy.value: Economy Class fares: 1 piece of hand baggage up to 8 kg.

weight_business_first.value: Business Class fares: 2 pieces of hand baggage, each up to 8 kg.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Whether a checked bag is included depends on your fare; some fares include hand baggage only.

included_allowance.value: Fares that include checked baggage allow 1 checked bag of up to 23 kg or up to 32 kg, depending on the fare. Fares with hand baggage only include no checked bag.
included_allowance.notes: Translated from the German check-in guide; the page does not say which fares carry 23 kg and which 32 kg.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

eu261.value: For delays, cancellations, denied boarding and downgrading, Air Dolomiti applies the international, EC and national rules in force, in particular Regulation (EC) No. 261/2004.

written_information.value: If you are denied boarding, or your flight is cancelled or delayed by more than two hours, you can ask at the service desk or gate for written information about your rights, in particular compensation and assistance.

complaints.value: Complaints go through the forms on Air Dolomiti's website and the carrier has 30 (thirty) days to respond; for Regulation 261/2004 cases, an attempt at reconciliation (ConciliaWeb or another ADR body) is mandatory before going to court.

online_checkin.value: Online check-in opens 30 hours before departure and is available for all flights operated by Air Dolomiti.

bag_drop.value: If you checked in online and have a checked bag, be at the baggage drop-off counter at least 40 minutes before departure; with hand baggage only, go straight to security with your boarding pass.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
